name: ncg-cql-mvp-engine
description: Production CQL execution path for the NCG-Heme MVP. NOT wired up in this sandboxed skeleton (see engine/cql_lite_cll.py docstring) because the HL7 cql-to-elm translator requires JVM + Maven Central access that this build environment doesn't have. Install and complete evaluate_via_cql_execution.js in an environment with that access.

scripts.translate: echo 'Run the HL7 cql-to-elm translator (cqframework/clinical_quality_language releases) against cql/*.cql to produce elm/*.json, then: node engine/js/evaluate_via_cql_execution.js <fhir-bundle.json>'
